translation.name: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002
translation.englishName: Yombe: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002 (Bible)

content.text: Lusakumunu kuidi mutu wowo wulemvokolo nzimbalꞌandi ;
masumu mandi mafukulu.
Lusakumunu kuidi mutu wowo Yave kankambu
ntangila disumu diandi,
ayi kambulu bukhita mu pheve andi.
Bu ndiba dio sui,
mimvesi miama milebakana mu kunga ku ndiba
nkunga mu lumbu kimvimba.
Bila muini ayi builu koko kuaku ziku kuba va minu.
Zingolo ziama zisukidi
banga mu thangu yi muini wu ngolo.
Buna ndizabikisa disumu diama,
ndisia fuka mambimbi mama ko.
Ndituba : “Ndiela lomba nlemvo mu zinzimbala ziama kuidi Yave.”
Buna ngeyo wulemvukila mambimbi ma disumu diama.
Buna diawu bika woso mutu wunkinzikanga mambu maku,
wela kusambila mu thangu yoyi kalenda kubakula.
Bukiedika mu thangu yi khuka nlangu yingolo
milendi kunlalumuna ko.
Ngeyo buangu kiama kieti kutsueka ;
ngeyo weti kukheba mu ziphasi.
Ngeyo wukunzungidilanga mu minkunga mi khudulu.
“Ndiela kumonisa ayi kulonga nzila yoyi fueti diatila,
ndiela kuvana ndongi ayi thaluꞌama
yela ba vadi ngeyo.
Kadi ba banga phunda
voti banga bulu kioki bantedilanga ‘mule’ ;
bibulu bikondolo diela,
vayi biobi binkangungu nsinga ayi sengo mu munu
bila nganu bilenda fikama va widi.”
Mabienga mawombo madi mu diambu di mutu wumbimbi ;
vayi luzolo lu ngolo lu ma Yave lunzungidilanga mutu wowo
wuntulanga diana diandi mu niandi.
Monanu khini
ayi luyangadala mu Yave beno basonga.
Luyimbila, beno boso luidi balulama mu mintima.
